correctness.rationale: Source equations (2)-(4) yield exact random affine position chain. Exact Beta(2,1) moments give E[A²]=1-zD and the stationary variance. Strict D monotonicity gives unique threshold, the variance-defect quadratic gives two calibration steps, and Gaussian-mixture strict Jensen prohibits exact Gaussian stationarity. E[A⁴]-1 modulo the calibration polynomial has opposite signs at the two roots, proving finite versus infinite stationary fourth moment. Analytic arguments address infinite time; 245 standalone checker tests only corroborate.

value.rationale: For Gaussian-target unadjusted HMC, exact temperature calibration of the stationary position variance is a natural performance metric. Two separate positive variance-zero points coexist with non-Gaussian laws, and one has infinite fourth moment even as its variance is exactly correct, exposing a meaningful failure of variance-only assessment. A sharp finite-variance step threshold adds a complete stability boundary for this exactly specified published algorithm; high-step findings are explicitly diagnostic.
